theater: 陝西涇原路寧州崑崙關

battle.name: 崑崙關之戰
battle.theater: 陝西涇原路寧州崑崙關
battle.brief: 一〇五三年皇祐五年十月，西夏大軍屯聚崑崙關，北宋經略使狄青不待定期，率軍自渭州夜行，次晨平明抵關，夏人猝不及防，宋軍直衝營壘，夏軍大潰，斬首數千級。此役全賴隱蔽行軍與突騎衝陣：卡面那件拜占庭希臘火同樣以火阻騎，配方卻從未東傳，宋軍手中的火器仍只是火箭與火毬。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是北宋與西夏。北宋在陝西設四路——環慶、鄜延、秦鳳、熙河——由陝西經略安撫使節制，皇祐五年秋朝廷以韓琦出鎮陝西，主持攻夏之議；涇原路的實際戰務由狄青以宣徽南院使、判涇原府之銜帶領，麾下有禁軍、廂軍與蕃兵，弓箭手多取自沿邊州縣，弓弩手是各路骨幹，馬匹則靠西北牧場與關中輸入湊數。西夏此時由毅宗李安全在位，樞密院與漢臣參議掌理軍務，出兵主力取自涼州、靈州一帶牧場，步卒居前列，鐵鷂子重騎居中，輕騎游騎兩翼抄截，糧秣靠境內屯墾與沿途掠奪。西夏與契丹保持往來，宋廷則以澶淵之盟牽制遼國，形成宋、遼、夏三邊互相消長的局面：宋要守住關中門戶，夏要打通通向渭州的道路，這條路上的堡寨與關隘，兩邊都必須伸手去拿。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Northern Song and Western Xia. The Song organised Shaanxi into four circuits — Huanqing, Fuyan, Qinfeng and Xihe — all under a commissioner for the pacification and defence of Shaanxi; in the autumn of the fifth year of Huangyou the court sent Han Qi to take charge of Shaanxi and to preside over the policy of attacking Xia, while the field work on the Jingyuan circuit was led by Di Qing, who carried the titles of Director of the Bureau of Ceremonies for the Southern Court and prefect of Jingyuan, with picked troops of the imperial guards, provincial soldiers and tribal auxiliaries under him. His archers were largely taken from the frontier prefectures and counties, the crossbowmen formed the backbone of every circuit, and horses remained scarce, being drawn from the pastures of the north-west and from the central plain. On the Xia side the ruler was then the Yizong Li Quanan, still a boy, and military business was conducted by the Privy Council and the Han Chinese officials of the central administration. Their main strength came from the pastures around Liangzhou and Lingzhou: infantry in front, the armoured iron-vult horse in the centre, light and free-ranging horse on the wings to cut around, and food and fodder supplied by the garrison farms inside Xia territory together with whatever could be taken on the march. Xia kept in contact with the Khitan, and the Song held the Liao in place under the Chanyuan treaty, so that Song, Liao and Xia formed a three-sided balance in which each checked the other. The Song had to hold the gateway of the central plain; Xia had to open the road towards Weizhou. The forts and passes along that road had to be taken by one side or the other, and this battle was the attempt to do it.
people: 崑崙關的主帥是狄青，字漢臣，汾州西河人，由行伍出身，善騎射，歷環慶、鄜延、秦鳳諸路而至涇原。此役的關鍵在於他不肯按常規用兵：西夏屯兵既久，宋軍若先約定期日再出師，消息一走漏，關下就會有所準備。狄青選擇封鎖消息、夜行急進，事前禁止將士得知全軍去向，出兵之後才宣布目的地；全軍戴青面面具，既是延續慶曆年間陣斬巨人後立下的威令，也讓士卒在暗夜行軍中彼此不辨。同一條命令還規定不許提前泄露行軍所向，違者按軍法從事。陝西經略安撫使韓琦是此役的策劃與後盾，也曾與狄青就出師節奏相持：韓琦主張定日子、齊舉動，狄青則力主出其不意，記錄以為二人終以奇襲為上。朝廷方面，仁宗批准出兵，卻把取勝的希望放在一位外鎮武將身上；後來朝中因文武之權與邊將威勢起爭，加上面涅將軍像的傳說，猜疑終使狄青出判辰州、尋貶隨州，此後不再起用。西夏一方的指揮層留在文牘與營務之中，實際統兵者的姓名在現存記載裡並不清晰。
peopleEn: The commander at Kunlun Pass was Di Qing, courtesy name Hanchen, a native of Xihe in Fenzhou, who had come up from the ranks and was an accomplished rider and archer, serving in turn on the Huanqing, Fuyan and Qinfeng circuits before he reached Jingyuan. The crux of this battle lay in his refusal to fight in the ordinary way. The Xia had been massed for some time, and if the Song had fixed a day in advance and marched out on it, the news would leak out and the Xia would be ready below the pass. Di Qing chose instead to seal the information and march by night: before the move the soldiers were forbidden to know where the whole army was going, and the destination was announced only once they were on the road. The entire force wore masks painted in his own blue face, both to carry on the authority he had established after killing the giant with the tattooed face in the Qingli years, and to keep the men from recognising one another on a night march. The same order forbade the leaking of the line of march, and those who broke it were to be dealt with under the articles of war. Han Qi, the commissioner for Shaanxi, was the planner and the sponsor of the campaign, and he too had stood at odds with Di Qing over the rhythm of the operation: Han Qi wanted a fixed day and a simultaneous move by all the columns, while Di Qing insisted on taking the enemy by surprise, and the record has it that the two ended by preferring the surprise. At the court the emperor Renzong approved the expedition, yet placed the hope of success on a military governor serving far from the capital; later, as the argument over the balance of civil and military power sharpened, and with the old story of the general whose face was painted blue still circulating, suspicion eventually carried Di Qing off to govern Chenzhou and then down to Suizhou, from which he was never brought back. On the Xia side the command was divided between the Privy Council and the frontier officers, and the names of the men who actually led the Xia army do not stand out clearly in the records that survive.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火屬於拜占庭帝國，約六七八年前後配在銅管與虹吸管中噴射，是稠厚難以澆熄的液態燃燒劑；帝國把配方列為最高機密，配方隨沉船失落，此後再無第二套辦法。它的戰術任務只有一個：把火直接送到正在移動的對手身上，使對手失去行動能力。銅管口徑有限、射程有限，所以它從來不是野戰的投射兵器，而是船首與城牆上的近距離阻斷工具。它沒有出現在崑崙關，原因很直接：這套裝備與配方從未離開拜占庭的宮廷與船塢，沒有任何線索顯示它曾東傳至中亞或宋境。〇五三年宋軍手上真正管用的，是弩與火藥武器。神臂弓已開始在西北諸路裝備，蹶張弓與霹靂弓張力更大，牀子弩架在車上能連發，步卒結陣用大刀長槍，車輛排列成活動拒馬擋住重騎，旗號金鼓用來整齊行列，橐車與馱馬搬運糧秣與箭矢。火器方面，《武經總要》所載的火箭、霹靂火毬與火砲已在軍中流傳，但它們是投擲的燃燒物或爆炸的殼體，靠的是火藥而非液體；宋軍沒有銅管，沒有能連續噴出稠厚火焰的器具，更沒有把燃燒劑灌進管道的本領。希臘火與宋軍火器的分別不在火本身，而在那一支銅管：一支能噴出成股的黏稠火焰，一支只能擲出一團火或一支燒著的箭。西夏方面則有鐵鷂子重騎、皮甲、步卒弓弩與橐駝馱運，兩軍的火力差距，主要落在弩與重甲的對撞上。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card belonged to the Byzantine Empire. From about 678 it was projected from bronze tubes and siphons, and it was a liquid burning fluid so thick that it could hardly be put out; the empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of producing it was ever found. Its tactical task was a single one: to deliver fire straight onto a target that was moving and rob it of its ability to move. Because the bore was small and the reach short, it was never a field weapon at all but a close-range blocking tool mounted on ship bows and on city walls. It did not appear at Kunlun Pass for a plain reason: neither the equipment nor the formula ever left the Byzantine court and dockyards, and not one thread of evidence connects it with Central Asia or with Song territory. What the Song army actually held in 1053 was the crossbow and the gunpowder weapon. The divine-power bow had begun to be issued on the north-western circuits, the treading bow and the thunder bow had far more tension, the bed crossbow was set up on waggons and could fire in sequence, the infantry closed up with broadswords and long spears, waggons were ranged in as movable barricades to hold the heavy horse back, flags and drums and gongs were used to keep the ranks in step, and baggage waggons and pack animals moved the grain and the arrows. On the fire side, the fire-arrows, the thunder fire-ball and the fire-pot described in the Wujing Zongyao were already in service, but they were thrown burning bodies or bursting shells, working on gunpowder and not on a liquid; the Song had no tube, no device able to spit a continuous stream of thick flame, and no craft for pouring a burning fluid into a pipe. The difference between Greek fire and the Song fire-weapons was not the fire itself but that bronze tube: one spits out a stream of sticky burning liquid, the other can only throw a ball of fire or a single shaft on fire. The Xia had the armoured iron-vult horse, leather armour, infantry bows and crossbows and camels for transport, and the gap in firepower between the two armies came down mainly to the collision of crossbow bolts against heavy armour.
tactics: 宋軍的接戰程序在出發之前就已經排定。狄青先遣斥候查清西夏屯兵的位置與佈防，得知大軍集中在崑崙關附近，才定下夜行方案：全軍以青面面具示人，禁令預知所向，士卒只知隨令旗而行；出營之後不設灶、不舉火，銜枚束馬，只聽鼓角，一路由渭州方向急行，趨向關下。平明抵達時，夏軍正在關前列陣整備，猝然遇襲，宋軍不與其列陣相持，直接以精騎為鋒、步弩為次，衝入營壘之中，把夏軍前段的步騎隔開，迫其隊形散亂；夏軍潰散，隊伍互相擠壓，宋軍乘勢追奔，斬首數千級，繳獲馬匹、鎧甲與帳幕甚多。防守一方在西夏一側並非全無準備，關城與前寨本可倚為屏障，但夜襲打亂了換防與炊煙的節奏，前寨既失，後寨與糧隊隨即崩解。戰後宋軍沒有遠追窮寇，而是收束關城、修築堡寨、部署屯田，把一次勝仗變成可以長期守禦的地形，這與范仲淹早年在西北推行的築寨屯田政策一脈相承：兵不出塞而境自固。補給方面，遠征只帶數日之糧，糧車隨行，屯田收成再供給堡寨，關城本身成為沿邊補給的節點。紀律上，嚴禁泄露行軍方向、按軍法連坐，正是這支部隊能在一夜之間完成奇襲的前提。
tacticsEn: The order of approach was settled before the army left. Di Qing first sent out scouts to find where the Xia troops were posted and how they were disposed, and only when he learned that the main body had been concentrated around Kunlun Pass did he fix on the plan for a night march: the whole army showed its blue face in masks, the men were forbidden to know the destination, and each man knew only that he was to follow the command flags; once out of camp no fires were lit and no cooking was done, the men went with their mouths stopped and the horses' bridles muffled, listening only to drum and horn, and the column moved hard from the direction of Weizhou towards the pass. When the army arrived at daybreak the Xia were still forming up and completing their preparations below the pass, and the shock of the attack broke their rhythm; the Song did not stand off and trade blows in a set formation but drove in with its picked horse in front and its infantry and crossbows behind, cut the leading edge of the Xia line away from the rest and forced the formation to come apart. The Xia broke and pressed against themselves, and the Song pursued, taking several thousand heads and carrying off horses, armour and tents in quantity. The defenders were not wholly unprepared: the pass city and the forward camps could have been used as cover, but the night attack disordered the changes of watch and the sequence of cooking smoke, and once the forward camp fell the rear camp and the baggage train came apart with it. After the fighting the Song did not chase the enemy to the end of the earth; they tightened the pass city, built forts and set up garrison farms, turning one victory into ground that could be held for years, in line with the policy of building forts and farming that Fan Zhongyan had pushed in the north-west earlier: the army did not leave the frontier and the frontier took care of itself. On supply, the expedition carried only a few days of grain with the waggons, the produce of the farms then fed the forts, and the pass city itself became a node of supply for the whole frontier line. On discipline, the sealing of the line of march and the liability of the whole unit for any breach were the precondition that allowed this force to complete a surprise movement in a single night.
data: 留下數字的只有宋人一方。斬首數千級，是《宋史·狄青傳》與《續資治通鑑》所共有的記載；夏軍被殺與被俘的具體人數、繳獲馬匹與器械的總數，兩書都只作概稱。兵力方面，夏軍集兵數萬，記載多有「眾十餘萬」一類的概數，實際到陣的步騎當在數萬之數，作戰骨幹是鐵鷂子；宋軍出戰兵力史無明記，按其輕裝疾行、一夜抵關的做法推算，當是精兵萬餘加上輜重隨行。距離最可推算：渭州至崑崙關走的是涇原、寧州之間的沿邊路，道路隨山塹盤折，一夜之間平明抵關，行程當在二百里上下。時間上，此役繫於皇祐五年即一〇五三年十月，個別記載作九月，相差一月。此前西夏已先後擾動綏州、定邊一線；此後宋夏邊境大體相安，直到一〇六〇年代神宗朝再啟戰端。崑崙關的所在，主流意見指在宋寧州境內，即今甘肅省慶陽市正寧縣一帶，控扼通往靈州的道路；另有考據指在環州西北或陝西其他地點，兩說相差不遠，皆在夏人南下的通道上。兵器方面，神臂弓有效射程在數百步，牀子弩射程略近而射速較高，這些數字只能作為當時弩兵性能的約數。卡面那件兵器則與此戰無涉：希臘火的使用記錄集中在七世紀的君士坦丁堡之圍與地中海海戰，此後配方失傳，再沒有出現在任何一份宋人檔冊裡。
dataEn: The only figures that survive are on the Song side. Several thousand severed heads is the account given in the biography of Di Qing in the History of Song and in the Xu Zizhi Tongjian alike; the exact numbers of Xia men killed and captured, and the totals of horses and equipment taken, are given by both books only as rough statements. On strength, the Xia gathered several tens of thousands; the records have the usual round figures of a hundred thousand and more, while the troops actually in the line were certainly a few tens of thousands with the armoured iron-vult horse as the fighting core. The Song force that fought is nowhere recorded in numbers, but from the manner of the operation — lightly loaded, moving hard, reaching the pass in a single night — it must have been some ten thousand picked men with the baggage following. Distance can best be reasoned out: the road from Weizhou to Kunlun Pass ran along the frontier between Jingyuan and Ningzhou, winding with the ridges and gullies, and since the army stood below the pass at daybreak after one night on the road, the march must have been on the order of two hundred li. On time, the battle is placed in the fifth year of Huangyou, that is the tenth month of 1053, though a few records give the ninth month, a difference of one month. Before it the Xia had already disturbed the Suizhou and Dingbian lines; after it the Song-Xia frontier stayed broadly quiet until the wars of the 1060s under Emperor Shenzong. The whereabouts of Kunlun Pass itself: the usual opinion puts it inside the Song prefecture of Ningzhou, in what is now Zhengning county of Qingyang in Gansu, commanding the road to Lingzhou; other scholarship places it to the north-west of Huanzhou or elsewhere in Shaanxi, and the two readings are not far apart, both lying on the road by which the Xia moved south. On weapons, the effective range of the divine-power bow was several hundred paces and the bed crossbow fell somewhat short of that but fired faster; such figures can only be taken as approximations of what the crossbowmen of the day could do. As for the weapon on the card, it has nothing to do with this battle: the recorded use of Greek fire is confined to the siege of Constantinople in the seventh century and to the naval fighting of the Mediterranean, and after the formula was lost it appears in no Song register at all.
cause: 打起上來的根由是慶曆和議之後那段沒有解決的邊界。元昊在〇四〇年代連破三川口、定川寨，一〇四四年和議劃下宋夏疆界，卻把綏州、綏德與橫山一帶的歸屬懸在兩邊之間；西夏的牧場、馬源與南下的孔道都在那一帶，宋廷則需要一座能屯田、能守禦、能屯兵的前進堡寨群。皇祐四年起，夏軍再犯綏州、定邊，剝奪堡寨，說明西夏不打算接受和議的現狀。宋廷的反應是轉守為攻：韓琦主持陝西，狄青整軍渭州一線，把西夏視為可擊之敵。導火索是西夏在崑崙關一帶集兵：夏軍把兵力擺在關下，既是進攻的前置，也是一道門戶，只要拿下關城，通往涇原的門就打開了。宋軍要做的，是不讓夏人察覺自己已至，用一次夜行奇襲把集兵之勢變成潰散。雙方其實都清楚這一線的分量：西夏不願失去南下與養馬的通道，宋不願讓關中門戶敞開；而實力、馬匹與糧秣的差距，使宋軍只能打一場短促而精確的會戰，打不成曠日持久的消耗戰。
causeEn: The root of the fighting lay in the unsettled boundary left behind by the Qingli settlement. Yuanhao had crushed the Song at Sanchuankou and at Dingchuanzhai in the 1040s, and the treaty of 1044 drew a frontier between the two states, but left the ownership of the Suizhou, Suide and Hengshan area hanging in the air. The pastures of Xia, its source of horses and the corridor by which it moved south all lay in that strip, while the Song court needed a group of forward forts that could be farmed, defended and garrisoned. From the fourth year of Huangyou the Xia army raided Suizhou and Dingbian again and took away the outlying forts, which showed that Xia was not prepared to accept the settlement as it stood. The court's answer was to turn from holding to attacking: Han Qi took charge of Shaanxi, Di Qing reorganised the Weizhou line, and Xia was treated as an enemy that could be beaten. The spark was the concentration of Xia troops around Kunlun Pass. The Xia had posted its army below the pass both as the prelude to an attack and as a doorway: take the pass city and the gate into Jingyuan stood open. What the Song army had to do was to prevent the Xia from learning that it had come, and to turn a massed army into a routed one with a single night march and surprise attack. Both sides understood the weight of that line. Xia could not afford to lose the road to the south and the ground on which it bred horses; Song could not let the gateway of the central plain stand open. And because of the gap in strength, in horses and in supply, the Song could only fight one short and precise meeting engagement; it could not afford a war of attrition.
impact: 此戰的意義大過戰果本身。狄青用一夜奇襲擊潰西夏大軍，等於向朝廷證明：西北邊軍不必靠城死守，也可以取勝。消息傳回汴京，仁宗召他入對，加官晉級，其後一路做到樞密使；宋廷對西夏的態度也從慶曆年間的守成轉為熙寧、元豐年間的用兵，奠定了一〇六〇年代大舉攻夏的經驗與膽量。技術面上，此役確立了宋軍夜行奇襲的樣式：封鎖消息、隱蔽行軍、平明突襲，後來多次西北戰役都沿用這套程序。政治面上，它同時替狄青招來麻煩——一位握重兵、得軍心、能自行決定出擊時機的武將，在文臣看來已經越過分寸，加上面涅將軍像的傳說，猜疑終使他出判辰州、貶隨州，宋此後對邊將的防範明顯收緊。對西夏來說，這一敗打斷了重新分割邊界的努力；元昊死後內部的權力交接尚未穩定，連遭挫敗更使樞府收斂進取之念，宋夏邊境隨之維持了近二十年的相安。技術上說，這裡仍是同一個課題：用火與器械改變對手的移動。拜占庭靠銅管裡的希臘火把敵船點成火炬，崑崙關的宋軍靠弩陣、夜行與旗鼓把敵騎困在關下；一個靠工藝奇技，一個靠體系與紀律。
impactEn: The significance of this battle was greater than its results. By breaking a Xia army in a single night of surprise, Di Qing proved to the court that the north-western frontier troops could win without simply shutting themselves up behind walls. The news reached Bianjing, the emperor Renzong summoned him to court and promoted him, and he went on to rise to the office of commissioner of the Privy Council; the attitude of the Song court towards Xia shifted from the defensive posture of the Qingli years to the wars of the Xining and Yuanfeng reigns, laying the experience and the confidence behind the large-scale campaigns against Xia in the 1060s. In tactical terms the battle established the Song pattern of night surprise: sealing the news, marching unseen, striking at daybreak, a procedure that later campaigns in the north-west repeatedly used. In political terms it also brought trouble to Di Qing, for a general who held heavy troops, had the confidence of his soldiers and could decide for himself when to strike had, in the view of the civil officials, already gone too far; added to the old story of the general with the painted face, this suspicion eventually carried him off to Chenzhou and down to Suizhou, and the Song's watchfulness over frontier commanders tightened visibly afterwards. For Xia the defeat interrupted the effort to redraw the frontier; with the transfer of power inside the state still unsettled after the death of Yuanhao, setbacks of this kind made the Privy Council curb its appetite for advance, and the Song-Xia frontier consequently kept the peace for nearly twenty years. In technological terms the same question was at issue: using fire and machinery to change the movement of the enemy. Byzantium turned enemy ships into burning torches with Greek fire in a bronze tube; the Song army at Kunlun Pass pinned the enemy horse below the pass with crossbows, a night march and the beat of drum and flag. One relied on a technical marvel, the other on a system and on discipline.
result: 結果是宋軍完勝：西夏集兵於崑崙關的部眾被突擊打散，斬首數千級，馬匹、鎧甲、帳幕盡為宋軍所得，餘眾退回關西，此後數年不敢再出窺寧州一線。宋軍乘勝收束關城，修築堡寨，部署屯田，把戰場變成沿邊防線上一個能長期自守的節點；宋廷沒有進一步深入夏境，因為關中、秦鳳的堡寨體系尚需鞏固，糧道與馬匹也不容許遠征。對西夏而言，這是一場不折不扣的敗仗，其樞府此後一度收斂攻勢，轉向整頓涼州、靈州一帶的屯田與牧場。對宋而言，崑崙關的重要性不在奪關本身，而在示範：一支裝備落後、靠堡寨與弩支撐的邊軍，同樣可以打出乾淨利落的一仗，邊軍士氣與朝廷信心都因此抬升。關於卡面這件兵器，可以確定的只有一句：希臘火與崑崙關沒有任何關係，它的配方在七世紀末已隨拜占庭的沉船失落，此後不曾再現；真正決定這一戰勝負的，是一夜的隱蔽行軍、平明的一擊、面具背後的紀律，以及弩手在關下的射準。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Song victory. The Xia troops massed at Kunlun Pass were scattered by the surprise attack, several thousand severed heads were taken, horses, armour and tents fell to the Song, and the survivors withdrew west of the pass, not daring to look into the Ningzhou line again for years afterwards. The Song pressed the advantage by tightening the pass city, building forts and posting garrison farms, turning the battlefield into a node on the frontier that could keep itself for a long time. The court did not carry the war deeper into Xia territory, because the fort system of Guanzhong and Qinfeng still had to be consolidated, and neither the supply roads nor the horses would carry a far expedition. For Xia this was an unmitigated defeat, and its Privy Council for a time pulled in its horns and turned to the farms and pastures around Liangzhou and Lingzhou. For the Song the importance of Kunlun Pass lay less in the taking of the pass than in the demonstration it made: a frontier army short of equipment, propped up by forts and crossbows, could fight a clean and tidy battle, and the morale of the frontier troops and the confidence of the court both rose with it. As for the weapon on this card, only one thing can be said with certainty: Greek fire had nothing to do with Kunlun Pass. Its formula was lost with the Byzantine ship in the late seventh century and never reappeared, and what actually decided this battle was one night of concealed marching, one stroke at daybreak, the discipline behind the masks, and the shooting of the crossbowmen below the pass.
